summary: Resolve the conflict between šayṭo and the corpus reading gəšriṭo.
rationale: The cited 96/60 actually reads gəšriṭo, with r, not g-šayṭo. Glossary lookup also files this same snake episode, with gəšriṭo and reference 96:60, under šrṭ 1, detransitive Preterit. The šyṭ example additionally cites grammar page 582, whose contents are not supplied. Check whether that source licenses an independent šyṭ reading before changing the word, root or box; the German translation alone cannot choose between them.
